mapper.insert: INSERT INTO safety_incident (source_type, industry_code, occupation_code, process_type, incident_type, occurred_at, severity, casualties, location, summary, detailed_cause, prevention_lesson, source_url, status) VALUES (#{sourceType}, #{industryCode}, #{occupationCode}, #{processType}, #{incidentType}, #{occurredAt}, #{severity}, #{casualties}, #{location}, #{summary}, #{detailedCause}, #{preventionLesson}, #{sourceUrl}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'PUBLISHED'))
mapper.update: UPDATE safety_incident SET industry_code = COALESCE(#{industryCode}, industry_code), occupation_code = COALESCE(#{occupationCode}, occupation_code), process_type = COALESCE(#{processType}, process_type), incident_type = COALESCE(#{incidentType}, incident_type), occurred_at = COALESCE(#{occurredAt}, occurred_at), severity = COALESCE(#{severity}, severity), casualties = COALESCE(#{casualties}, casualties), location = COALESCE(#{location}, location), summary = COALESCE(#{summary}, summary), detailed_cause = COALESCE(#{detailedCause}, detailed_cause), prevention_lesson = COALESCE(#{preventionLesson}, prevention_lesson), status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE safety_incident SET status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT si.* FROM safety_incident si JOIN safety_incident_keyword sik ON sik.incident_id = si.id WHERE si.status = 'PUBLISHED'
AND sik.keyword_id IN
#{kwId}
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN si.industry_code = #{industryCode} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), si.occurred_at DESC
